items.title: Core MCP Server & Schema Registry
items.description: The foundational FastMCP server exposing five tools (`get_flags`, `list_subcommands`, `validate_command`, `detect_version`, `list_supported`), backed by a versioned schema registry of pre-extracted CLI flag JSON files. Includes the Python extractor package with Cobra, help-parser, and custom adapters, and four initial CLI configs (oc, kubectl, kustomize, podman).
items.outcome: A running MCP server that returns version-pinned flag schemas for ≥4 CLIs, rejects hallucinated flags via `validate_command`, and passes 80% test coverage in CI.
items.scope: Five MCP tools; schema_registry module; extractor package with cobra (`__complete` primary, help-text fallback), help-parser, and custom adapters; `clis/` YAML config model; `schemas/` registry; 4 initial CLIs (oc 4.18–4.22, kubectl 1.31–1.35, kustomize 5.3–5.5, podman 5.2–5.4); test suite ≥80% coverage.

items.title: Schema Extraction CI Pipeline
items.description: Generic, config-driven schema refresh pipeline: each `clis/<name>.yaml` registration carries one `obtain` block (artifact URL, checksum URL, archive format, member path, optional version pointer). `python -m extractor.refresh --base <rev> --head <rev>` detects changed registrations, downloads and SHA-256 verifies each declared version's binary, runs the extractor, and publishes `schemas/<tool>/<version>.json` only after every selected version succeeds (all-or-nothing). Fork pull requests receive exit 2 and a catalog diff list instead of a branch push.
items.outcome: Merging a new `clis/<name>.yaml` config (with an `obtain` block) automatically populates the schema registry without any manual extraction step. A registration change for a CLI this project has never fetched before produces its catalog without a code change.
items.scope: `extractor/obtain.py` (download, SHA-256, unpack raw/tar.gz/zip with up to 3-layer unwrap); `extractor/refresh.py` (change detection, temp-dir all-or-nothing publish, exit 0/1/2, version retirement); `extractor/cli_config.py` extended with `ObtainConfig`; `obtain` block added to `clis/oc.yaml`, `clis/kubectl.yaml`, `clis/kustomize.yaml`, `clis/podman.yaml`; `.github/workflows/extract-schemas.yml` updated (90 min timeout, `python -m extractor.refresh`, fork-PR `--no-push` path); `CONTRIBUTING.md` obtain-block reference; pytest coverage of token fill, checksum, unpack, publish, no-push, and removal.

items.title: OCI Artifact Publishing
items.description: GitHub Actions release workflow that packages the `schemas/` directory as an OCI artifact and pushes it to a container registry (e.g. quay.io) on each tagged release. Enables air-gapped OCP clusters to pull the schema registry without internet access.
items.outcome: Air-gapped enterprise deployments can pull a version-tagged OCI artifact containing the complete schema registry and mount it into the server container. No internet access required at server runtime.
items.scope: `.github/workflows/publish-schemas-oci.yml`; OCI packaging of `schemas/` directory; quay.io push on `v*` tags; documentation for OCI pull usage in `Containerfile` and README; `SCHEMA_REGISTRY_PATH` env var to point at mounted OCI content.

items.title: validate_command accepts bundled short flags
items.description: `validate_command` treats a bundled short-flag token such as `-it` as one unknown flag, so `podman run -it fedora bash` is reported invalid although the schema has both `-i` (`--interactive`) and `-t` (`--tty`). Agents that trust the tool then rewrite a correct command. The fix expands a single-dash token into its letters when each letter is a known shorthand of the matched subcommand.
items.outcome: Correct commands that bundle known short flags validate as `valid=true`; a bundle with any unknown letter is still `valid=false`, and the error names the unknown letters. No other validation result changes.

items.title: OpenShift / Lightspeed Integration
items.description: Integration of cli-schema-mcp as a companion MCP server in the Red Hat Lightspeed portfolio — initially OpenShift Lightspeed (fixes the documented v1.1.3 version mismatch bug), then RHEL Lightspeed and Ansible Lightspeed.
items.outcome: _to be defined_ — depends on Lightspeed BU alignment conversation.

items.title: Community CLI Registry & Ecosystem
items.description: Open source community contribution model enabling CNCF and non-Red Hat CLI maintainers to add their tools to the schema registry. Includes community governance, CNCF CLI coverage (flux, crossplane, istioctl, etc.), InstructLab fine-tuning dataset publication, and conference presence (DevConf, Red Hat Summit).
items.outcome: ≥3 non-Red Hat CLIs contributed by external maintainers. InstructLab fine-tuning dataset published from versioned schemas. Community contribution model documented and self-sustaining.
items.scope: `CONTRIBUTING.md` expansion (already started); `MAINTAINERS.md`; community CNCF CLI YAML configs; `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/new-cli-request.yml` (already done); InstructLab dataset export script; conference talk submission.
